title: Project on Undertrial Prisoners & CLE Launched at NUSRL
summary: NUSRL, Ranchi initiates a dedicated project to provide information and updates on legal aid, continuous legal education, and prison outreach for undertrial prisoners, as directed by the university administration.

title: Orientation on Legal Aid for Undertrial Prisoners
summary: Orientation session for law students and faculty on the constitutional mandate of free legal aid under Article 39A and the role of legal services authorities in Jharkhand.

title: Continuous Legal Education Workshop
summary: Workshop on criminal procedure, bail jurisprudence, and prisoners' rights for student volunteers and young advocates.

title: Prison Outreach Programme
summary: Structured outreach visit to assess legal aid needs and sensitise stakeholders on undertrial prisoners' rights. Conducted in coordination with legal services authorities.

title: Multi-Stakeholder Consultation on Undertrial Justice
summary: Consultation bringing together academia, legal aid advocates, and criminal justice stakeholders to discuss challenges and opportunities in undertrial justice.
